AI insights

This report is based on Monnit sensor data from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-09. The week's peak temperature was 28.1°C in Bed 3 on 2026-08-04 at 19:50, against a low of 21.7°C in Study on 2026-08-07 at 07:50. Humidity peaked at 57.9% in Hall on 2026-08-04 at 14:00, falling to 45.5% in Toilet down on 2026-08-05 at 13:30. The tightest condensation margin was 6.0°C in Loft 2, comfortably above the 3°C elevated-risk threshold. Against the CIBSE Guide A comfort standard, which targets 21°C in living areas, 18°C in bedrooms, and 40-60% relative humidity, Hall was closest to comfort at 23.8°C and 53.3% humidity, while Bed 3 sat furthest away at 25.2°C and 50.9% humidity, well above its 18°C bedroom target. Daily mean indoor temperature peaked early in the week at 26.2°C on 2026-08-04 before easing to 23.2°C by 2026-08-07. Around 13:00 on 2026-08-05, Dining, Hall and Lounge cooled together, averaging a 1.4°C drop with a largest single change of 1.8°C, consistent with windows being opened for ventilation. Separately, Network saw the week's sharpest individual swing, dropping 3.2°C from 31.1°C to 27.9°C between 14:10 and 14:40 that same day, consistent with brief ventilation of the network cupboard.
